Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hemoglobin and mild proteinuria may reflect inflammation. Low specific gravity could suggest dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
